posts.title: Grokking DelBrag: Out-of-Band On-Chain Fraud Proofs through Circuit Garbling @ Bitcoin++ Austin
posts.description: My talk at Bitcoin++ on how DelBrag protocols work, including detailed schematics and timing analysis. Also introduces new concepts of optimistic circuit consistency checks. Get the Slides Here

posts.title: Delbrag
posts.description: Delbrag is a paper explaining how garbled circuits can be applied to make BitVM style constructs fraud proofs substantially more efficient, at the cost of increased out-of-band information exchange. Delbrag was originally authored in November, 2024, but wasn’t published sooner as the author procrastinated. Read the full paper.
